summary_ja: 承認の審査において、トレーディング・デスクの要件を満たすかを審査することを定める。
summary_en: Provides that the Commissioner examines whether the trading desk requirements are satisfied when considering an approval.
paragraphs: When the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency intends to grant the approval under paragraph (1) of the preceding Article, the Commissioner shall examine whether the requirements listed in the items of Article 249-3, paragraph (3) are satisfied.
